name: Elevator Interior
summary: Compact open-door elevator car with a rear mirror, unlabelled buttons, supported rails and luminous ceiling panel.
description: Original GJH Virtual Mall car interior with four stowed telescopic sliding leaves, eight unlabelled floor buttons, rear mirror, rear and side handrails, warm-white ceiling light and neutral wall panelling. No readable text, logos, product packaging or external assets.
author: Yap Wei Jun project / agent-assisted procedural modeling
creation_method: Original deterministic Blender Python geometry with three shared materials and vertex colours. No random inputs, external models, textures, fonts or images.

interface.runtime: Static open pose only. No animation, button logic, passenger transport, colliders or live planar mirror reflection. Emissive ceiling surface exports no light object.

accuracy_notes: Dimensions and statistics are measured from the delivered GLB; clearances and button count are measured from the saved source. Outside envelope is approximately 1.6m wide, 1.5m deep and 2.4m high. The mirror is a low-roughness metallic PBR surface reflecting the viewer environment. Neutral wall, floor and control colours share one vertex-coloured material. Not a surveyed installation or engineering/safety certification. Full mall assembly, aggregate 200 draw-call budget, physical mobile devices and WebKit are unverified.

attribution.credit: Original procedural geometry, vertex colours and three shared materials. No external assets.

rights: Original asset; reuse in the owner's projects is authorized. Public redistribution terms have not been specified.
